paper: R&D-Agent: An LLM-Agent Framework Towards Autonomous Data Science
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock instantiation of the paper's general autonomous data-science workflow, not R&D-Agent-Quant and not a reproduction of the paper's MLE-Bench medal claims.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Iterate a decoupled Research phase (planning, exploration-path structure, memory, reasoning) and Development phase (coding, evaluation), store solutions in an exploration graph, then submit the best solution.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Section 3.3, MD-Planning and MD-Exploration Path Structuring
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Start with diverse parallel directions, then exploit stronger branches, prune weaker paths, and merge strengths at the final stage.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Section 3.3, MD-Scientific Reasoning Pipeline and MD-Memory Context
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Form explicit hypotheses, virtually evaluate alternatives before implementation, and share strong ideas across branches while retaining diversity.

primary_source_anchors.anchor: Section 3.3, MD-Coding Workflow and MD-Evaluation Strategy
primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Prototype before full evaluation and compare top branch solutions using standardized fixed splits and an aggregated validation layer.

research_development_policy.branch_training_score: mean monthly Spearman RankIC minus one standard error over the 96-month research split
research_development_policy.aggregated_validation_score: mean of three fixed fold RankIC means minus one half of their population standard deviation
finalist_constructions: equal blend of six branch winners
equal blend of the three strongest branch winners on validation
research_development_policy.final_selection: highest aggregated validation score with deterministic lexical tie-breaking
research_development_policy.score_refresh: monthly using only outcomes with realization dates before the formation month
research_development_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: frozen value-weighted long-short deciles with the six cost and missing-return paths

preserved_elements: a decoupled research phase and development/evaluation phase
multiple diverse exploration branches rather than one greedy chain
a structured exploration graph with within-branch exploitation
virtual evaluation that filters ideas before the final development stage
cross-branch memory through merged finalist solutions
standardized train-validation separation inaccessible to the final current-month score
aggregated evaluation of top solutions on identical validation folds
submission of one selected solution after the bounded search
approximated_elements: semantic JKP hypotheses replace arbitrary Kaggle task solutions
fixed formula operators replace LLM-generated research ideas
chronological RankIC replaces task-specific Kaggle metrics
monthly rolling windows replace a 12-hour wall-clock budget
deterministic branch merging replaces LLM collaborative communication
the common portfolio adapter replaces a Kaggle submission artifact
invented_elements: the six named financial hypothesis branches and their signed characteristics
the four formula operators within every branch
the one-standard-error training penalty and half-standard-deviation validation penalty
the all-branch and top-three merged finalists
